list.text: Discover our facial biotherapies, a selection of rituals designed to restore your skin's balance and vitality:

sensitiva.title: Sensitive Biotherapy
sensitiva.subtitle: Reactive Skin · Calm and Protection
sensitiva.summary: A biological therapy designed to restore balance to the most delicate and reactive skin.

tabs.description: A calming ritual that strengthens the skin's protective barrier, easing redness and tightness through Biopolar Water™ and botanical actives such as calendula and cornflower.
tabs.benefits:
• Instantly soothes irritation.
• Reinforces natural hydration.
• Reduces skin reactivity.
• Brings softness and comfort.
tabs.ideal:
• You have sensitive or reactive skin.
• You suffer from redness or flaking.
• Your skin feels tight after cleansing.
• You are looking for a gentle, respectful ritual.
tabs.actives: Calendula, Cornflower, Chamomile, Aloe Vera, Biopolar Water™.

iluminante.title: Illuminating Biotherapy
iluminante.subtitle: Even Tone · Light and Depigmentation
iluminante.summary: Targets hyperpigmentation to restore luminosity and an even tone to the face.

tabs.description: An advanced treatment that regulates melanin production and refines the skin's texture. Ideal for dull skin or skin with sun and hormonal spots.
tabs.benefits:
• Softens dark spots and marks.
• Evens out facial tone.
• Provides instant luminosity.
• Regenerates damaged tissue.
tabs.ideal:
• Your skin tone looks dull or uneven.
• You have sun or age spots.
• You want to recover your natural glow.
• You have acne marks.
tabs.actives: Bearberry, Liquorice, natural Vitamin C, Ginkgo Biloba.

detox.title: Detox Biotherapy
detox.subtitle: Purity · Balance and Deep Cleansing
detox.summary: A deep biological cleanse that drains toxins and regulates excess sebum production.

tabs.description: A purifying ritual that cleanses the pores without aggression, balancing the pH and restoring vitality to blemish-prone skin.
tabs.benefits:
• Eliminates toxins and blackheads.
• Regulates excess oil.
• Tightens pores and refines texture.
• Prevents acne breakouts.
tabs.ideal:
• You have oily or combination skin.
• You notice enlarged pores and impurities.
• You live in a polluted environment.
• Your skin feels heavy or congested.
tabs.actives: Burdock, Nettle, White Clay, Lemon, Thyme.

antiaging.title: Anti-Aging Biotherapy
antiaging.subtitle: Restructuring · Firmness and Youth
antiaging.summary: A restructuring therapy that fights cellular ageing and restores the skin's density.

tabs.description: A ritual designed for skin in need of extra nourishment and firmness. It biologically stimulates collagen and elastin production, filling in wrinkles from within.
tabs.benefits:
• Biological lifting effect.
• Fills in expression lines.
• Improves elasticity and firmness.
• Deeply nourishes.
tabs.ideal:
• You notice a loss of firmness along the facial contour.
• You have wrinkles or pronounced lines.
• You are looking for natural rejuvenation.
• Your skin feels thin or fragile.
tabs.actives: Resveratrol, Argan Oil, Soy, Rosehip, Shea Butter.

regeneradora.title: Regenerating Biotherapy
regeneradora.subtitle: Renewal · Hydration and Energy
regeneradora.summary: An intensive biotherapy for devitalised, dry skin lacking cellular energy.

tabs.description: An intensely nourishing ritual that restores plumpness and volume to the face, repairing damage caused by external aggressors.
tabs.benefits:
• Long-lasting hydration.
• Express tissue regeneration.
• Smooths the skin's texture.
• Restores flexibility and plumpness.
tabs.ideal:
• Your skin is very dry or dehydrated.
• You notice a lack of vitality and freshness.
• You have been exposed to sun or extreme cold.
• You want supple, plump skin.
tabs.actives: Plant-based Hyaluronic Acid, Avocado, Murumuru Butter, Seaweed.
